title.fr: Filtrage : généralités et fonction de transfert

formula: H(jω) = V_s / V_e   (fonction de transfert complexe)
sketch:
Observe: split view — schematic slot on the left (any of R, C, L
arranged in a two-port), Bode plot |H(jω)| and arg(H) on the right,
both axes log-frequency. Student sweeps a frequency source and
watches input and output sinusoids on a mini-scope while the plot
auto-populates from the sweep. HUD shows H = V_s / V_e as complex
gain. Experiment: build a simple RC low-pass, verify the Bode plot
matches the closed-form 1 / (1 + jRCω). Evaluate: given only a
Bode magnitude curve, classify the filter (passe-bas / haut /
bande / réjection). Wrinkle: log-axis reading practice —
identifies decades.
